:::{#exr-null-space-practice}
#### Finding a null space

The [null space](#def-null-space) of a [matrix](linear-algebra-matrices.qmd#def-matrix) $\matr{A}$
holds every $\vecf{x}$ with $\matr{A}\vecf{x} = \vzero$.
Let

$$
\matr{A} = \sbmat{1 & 2 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 1}.
$$

Find $\mathcal{N}(\matr{A})$ as a [span](linear-algebra-subspaces.qmd#def-span).

::: {.callout-tip}
#### Hint

Write out the two entries of $\matr{A}\vecf{x}$ and make each equal to $0$.

:::

:::
